newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany-Israel cargo space up on summer schedule.
newsitem.headline: Germany-Israel cargo space up on summer schedule.

text.p: Cargo capacity from Germany to Israel has increased this summer as new flights to tourist destinations have been added.
Four airlines will operate 44 weekly flights, three flights more than summer 1996, from eight German airports to Tel Aviv and the resort of Eilat, an Israel tourist office statement said.
Deutsche Lufthansa AG has started a weekly Airbus A320 flight from Duesseldorf via Munich to Tel Aviv, it added.
The German national carrier also operates 11 flights a week from Frankfurt and four from Munich to Tel Aviv.
El Al flies daily from Frankfurt to Tel Aviv and Eilat and nine times a week from three other German airports, the statement said.
The Israeli carrier started a 747-100 all-freight flight from Tel Aviv via Frankfurt to New York in February to target the European and U.S. freight market.
Holiday airlines Aero Lloyd and Arkia also fly direct services between Germany and Israel. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
